fact_english: Some mantis shrimp, which also live in Philippine waters, punch with club-like claws so fast that they can crack snail shells.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: May mga tatampal, mantis shrimp, na sumusuntok gamit ang parang pamalo, kaya nilang basagin ang kabibe ng suso!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Hipon na boksingero. Huwag mong aawayin sa palengke.

after_text: Pero kalahati lang ang narinig ng bayan: akin.
why_here: After the public hears only half of Indio's answer, 'akin', and before JM bursts in with the court papers. The viewer waits through the break to see what the misheard word costs him. Moved on 13 Nov because the old cut after Bea's question 'kanino ang mga sasakyan?' split her interview question from Indio's reply 'Akin'.
